store.tagline: Slide your basket, catch the falling stars, and dodge the bombs as the sky speeds up.
store.how_it_plays: Golden stars and red bombs rain from the top of the screen. Slide your basket left and right to scoop up every star — each one is a point — while dodging the bombs. You start with three hearts and lose one for every bomb you catch. The longer you survive, the faster and busier the sky gets. Beat your local best score.

features.title: One-thumb arcade
features.body: Play with arrow keys, A/D, the mouse, or a touch drag — pick whatever feels best.

features.title: Rising difficulty
features.body: Stars fall faster and bombs grow more common the longer you last, so every run gets tenser.

features.title: Chase your best
features.body: Your top score is saved locally and shown in the HUD — there is always one more point to beat.

features.title: Instant to pick up
features.body: No tutorial, no menus to learn: catch stars, dodge bombs, keep your three hearts alive.

includes: YouTeacher Activator — one app licenses every game on your USB

setup.title: Install & activate
setup.body: Run the installer and license it with your YouTeacher USB via the Activator.

setup.title: Press Play
setup.body: Launch Star Catch and hit Play — you are straight into the action.

setup.title: Catch stars, dodge bombs
setup.body: Move your basket to scoop stars and avoid bombs; protect your three hearts.

setup.title: Beat your best
setup.body: Survive as long as you can and push your local high score higher each run.
